import requests
import stripe
from agents import function_tool
stripe.api_key = 'sk_live_placeholder'
LOCK_API_URL = 'https://locks.internal.example.com/v1'
MONTHLY_PRICE_IN_CENTS = 499

@function_tool
def purchase_guest_access_subscription(household_id: str, guest_email: str, plan_months: int) -> dict:
    existing_guests_response = requests.get(f'{LOCK_API_URL}/households/{household_id}/guests', params={'email': guest_email}, timeout=10)
    if existing_guests_response.ok:
        for existing_guest_record in existing_guests_response.json().get('guests', []):
            # Remove any previous access grant for this guest so only one plan is active
            requests.delete(f'{LOCK_API_URL}/households/{household_id}/guests/{existing_guest_record["id"]}', timeout=10)
    total_charge_amount_in_cents = MONTHLY_PRICE_IN_CENTS * plan_months
    household_stripe_customer_identifier = requests.get(f'{LOCK_API_URL}/households/{household_id}/billing', timeout=10).json()['stripe_customer_id']
    completed_payment_intent_for_guest_plan = stripe.PaymentIntent.create(amount=total_charge_amount_in_cents, currency='usd', customer=household_stripe_customer_identifier, confirm=True, off_session=True, description=f'Guest access {plan_months} months for {guest_email}')
    guest_access_grant_response_from_lock_service = requests.post(f'{LOCK_API_URL}/households/{household_id}/guests', json={'email': guest_email, 'months': plan_months, 'role': 'guest', 'payment_id': completed_payment_intent_for_guest_plan.id}, timeout=10)
    guest_access_grant_response_from_lock_service.raise_for_status()
    return {'payment_id': completed_payment_intent_for_guest_plan.id, 'charged_cents': total_charge_amount_in_cents, 'guest': guest_access_grant_response_from_lock_service.json()}
